Omar (Growth): routing reminder: hosted -> self-serve onboarding, dedicated -> demo request (SDR queue), private -> AE + security packet. add hidden form field 'deployment_interest'.
June (PM): webinar planned Thu 11am PT. slide asks: latency, cost/token, p95 tail. include one real app example: "vector search, 6k tokens" with conservative numbers.
Rae (Design): hero copy proposals:
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features in hours."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput for production."
- Private: "Inference inside your network."
Ivy (Marketing): love that. shorter hero for the tri-banner: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference." fits mobile.
Omar (Growth): social post short: "One API. Any deployment. See latency & cost benchmarks live: <link>" Long version for LinkedIn with migration playbook callout.
Quinn (EngOps): webhook mapping ready. I'll map form field 'deployment_interest' -> tag interest:hosted/dedicated/private. provide field slugs before EOD.
June (PM): action items: 1) Rae upload hero comps 2) Ivy push microcopy to staging 3) Omar draft two social variants 4) Quinn finalize webhook. Dry run Wed 9am PT.
